input.free_text_description: This system is an e-commerce platform that serves User, Customer roles. The platform provides capabilities for mongo container dev mode, account, account repository. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to interact with account functionality, so that I can accomplish my account-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with customer functionality, so that I can accomplish my customer-related tasks.
As a User, I want to use mongo container dev mode capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use account capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
As a User, I want to use account repository capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
